name: Hunt Leader
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) When you deal damage, you mark an enemy for 10 seconds, causing any of your pet damage to heal you for 2433 Health and restore 1216 Stamina. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.

name: Huntsman's Warmask
lines: (1 item) Dealing damage with a Bash or fully-charged Heavy Attack places the Mark of Hircine on your target for 1 minute. While active, you gain Minor Berserk, increasing damage done by 5%, and deal 15% more damage to the target and 50% less damage to all other enemies. If the enemy dies while marked, you gain 2418 Stamina or Magicka, based off your highest maximum resource. This effect can trigger up to every 10 seconds.

name: Iceheart
lines: (2 items) When you deal Critical Damage, you have a 20% chance to gain a damage shield that absorbs 5000 damage for 6 seconds. While the damage shield holds, you deal 260 Frost damage to all enemies within 5 meters of you every 1 second. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds and the damage scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Icy Conjurer
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Applying a minor debuff to your enemy conjures a non-reflectable Ice Wraith that will charge into your enemy, dealing 3070 Frost Damage over 10 seconds. This effect reveals you, can occur every 10 seconds, scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, and is considered pet damage.

name: Ilambris
lines: (2 items) When you deal Flame or Shock Damage, you have a 33% chance to bring down a meteor shower that deals 146 Flame damage and 146 Shock damage to all enemies within 4 meters every 1 second for 5 seconds. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Immolator Charr
lines: (2 items) Adds 1206 Maximum Health, When you take damage while below 50% Health, gain immunity to immobilization, snares, and crowd control effects for 10 seconds. This effect can occur once every 40 seconds.

name: Immortal Warrior
lines: (5 items) When you take damage while below 35% Health you gain Major Protection for 20 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 10%. This effect can occur once every 20 seconds.

name: Imperial Physique
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) While you are in Imperial City, you tap into the power of the Tel Var Stones you are carrying, increasing your Health, Magicka, and Stamina by 1032. While you have a 4x Tel Var Stone multiplier this effect is increased by 600%.
